# DevDigest observability

Connects Claude Code to Sentry for issues, events and releases.

## What it adds

- Skills: `log-query`, `alert-rules`
- Commands: `incident-summary`

## Install

```text
/plugin install devdigest-observability@dev-digest-ai-marketplace
```

## What it runs

### sentry

Signs in with your Sentry account on first use.
